items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: was it Jay McShann that Bird used to play with?

ctx.x: Yes. Well it’s a beautiful recording and it sounded like, you know, like you were in church.

Well the organ is a church instrument. You know that’s why black people love it so much, you know, certain black people. Certain black people don’t like organ or didn’t like it because they felt that it kept them in that old school church blues idiom and they wanted to go forward you know. I said, “Well you ever heard Larry Young Junior?” They said, “Oh yeah I heard that noise and all that wild stuff.” I said, “Yeah but it’s stuff like ‘Unity’ and that is “Zoltan,” that other ones that he did too.” You know they…
